svg.title: K16 · The watchman who skipped a gate: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 16: 3 nodes (one is tainted, z2h-vip); DaemonSet watchman (one Pod per node, wants: fewer than 3); Pods watchman (one gate has, nobody). Your mission: A watchman at every gate? Count them.
